as s from_json schema/schema.json
# Valid, a time checked as a string
as at time 2026-09-22T08:10:04.5+02:00
as org str ksoft
as good obj org $org at $at
validate @good $s
# Wrong in several places, inf read as the map JSON would carry
as tags split silt,x,silt ,
as loud str KSoft
as bad obj org $loud ratio 0.:float=inf tags $tags extra 0.:null
validate @bad $s
as two set @good .ratio 0.:float=1.5
validate @two $s
# A scalar and an empty collection as the document
as number obj type $org
as wants set @number .type 0.:str="number"
validate @org $wants
as none arr
validate @none $wants
# The schema true and the schema false
validate @good 0.:bool=true
validate @good 0.:bool=false
# Refused
as n obj n 0.:int=3
as three get @n .n
validate @good 0.:int=3
as broken set @wants .minimum 0.:str="1"
validate @three $broken
as list set @wants .enum 0.:int=1
validate @three $list
as ahead obj pattern 0.:str="(?=a)"
validate @org $ahead
as edge obj pattern 0.:str="\\\\bword"
validate @org $edge
as inside obj pattern 0.:str="[\\\\D]"
validate @org $inside
as zero obj multipleOf 0.:int=0
validate @three $zero
as blob set @good .k 0.:blob=x
validate @blob $s
validate @good 3.0:int=1
